department: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so earlier is better.

gre_subject.value: There is no chemical engineering subject GRE; the department does not use GRE scores.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required and scores are not factored into admission.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not factored into our admission process; there is no advantage to providing a GRE score with your application.

supervisor.value: The ChBE apply page does not say whether you need an advisor before applying.

funding.value: Students in good standing are guaranteed full support (stipend, tuition, research costs) for their whole PhD; no proof of finances needed at application.
funding.quote: Students who remain in good standing, and continue to make satisfactory academic progress in the program based on their annual reviews are guaranteed full financial support for the duration of their studies in our graduate program.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the minimum; no master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: No, a bachelor's degree is the minimum education requirement to join our PhD program.

notes: All students must TA three to four semesters, so a TOEFL speaking score of 24 (or IELTS speaking 8 to teach) is expected; 20-23 may be considered. No terminal master's admissions.
